scope: all models including genesis; fork model special category removed by MOE3

regular_coinbase.bft_amount: F=floor(50*C/1000), split once from canonical source C
regular_coinbase.bft_recipient_plan: authenticated prior roster and ongoing service eligibility; separate from retirement votes

bond_lots.amount_basis: current unspent remaining amount under model-specific responsibility
bond_lots.same_actor_multi_role: classify each disjoint funding lot, not the whole account

retirement_case.open_requires: canonical authorized case-open record, model/root, anchor, bounded deadline and separate purpose quorum
retirement_case.quorum: inherited MAD2 n=3f+1, q=2f+1, concrete roster fixed before case
open_freezes: target AMM buy/sell and LP addition
retirement_case.reject_or_timeout: remove only case freeze, retain independent stop and original liabilities
retirement_case.retire_requires: dedicated MODEL_RETIRE quorum bound to exact current case, source scope, state sequence and policy

retirement_assets.pool_misaka: 100 percent of current real reserve r of the target nonredeemable pool; historical A totals and V excluded
retirement_assets.registrant_bond: 100 percent of remaining target model MODEL_REGISTRANT lots
retirement_assets.mining_bond: 100 percent of remaining target model MODEL_MINING lots
retirement_assets.unissued_mining_reward: cancel unissued allocation; do not count as actual token burn
retirement_assets.unconfirmed_mining_position_escrow: retire current position_atoms once; no MISAKA valuation mint
retirement_assets.settled_mining_outputs: preserve, without waiving individual Court liability
retirement_assets.panel_gate_c_verification_bond: always protected from BFT bulk burn, regardless of suspected misconduct
retirement_assets.established_verification_rewards: preserve MISAKA entitlement and original service terms
retirement_assets.disputed_verification_reservation: keep separate for Court; not a mining reward
retirement_assets.pool_position_inventory: freeze in closed market; no new redeem authority
retirement_assets.settled_holder_position_balance: preserve quantity; target AMM closes and real backing is burned

court_slash.S: cumulative actually recovered MISAKA penalty for one final Court offence, within original liability cap
court_slash.recipients: qualified offence-linked Panel/Gate C discovery or prosecution plan; combined 49 percent
court_slash.collection_key: offence_id plus unique collection_id and funding-source consumption
court_slash.recipient_plan: fixed for offence; distribute only delta_Q or escrow until one finite final distribution
court_slash.missing_qualified_recipient: finite dedicated reward escrow, unused unqualified remainder burned at original terminal deadline
court_slash.terminal_unclaimed_reward_burn: qualified reward not paid by the original deadline is burned from dedicated escrow

atomicity.retirement: state, pool burn, lot consumption, reward cancellation/retirement, tombstone and one-time record commit together
atomicity.court_collection: funding recovery, reward payment/reservation, burn and cumulative ledger commit together
atomicity.court_before_bft: consume source once; preserve already established finder/service rights
atomicity.bft_before_court: no re-collection of burned source; actual recovery zero implies no additional bounty
atomicity.reorg: restore exact prior assets, liabilities, payments, cumulative counters and status
